expect_red: a write reads the identity inbox once per page: the next seq, the log and the next write's reads open only a file that is new since, and the installed meshes open no file

mutations.contract: An event file read once is that event for the rest of the page (the inbox is append-only, one file per event, never rewritten), so a write opens only files that are new since the last read. Reading the whole inbox three times per write was 2025 folder calls and 15-30 s on Jeff's 101-file log.
mutations.note: Treats every listed name as unread, which is the pre-2026-11-19 behaviour: every read opens every file.
